name: openstatus
summary: openstatus is an AGPL-3.0 status page and uptime monitoring service that can be self-hosted. The free Hobby plan has 1 page with 3 components. Paid plans cost $30, $100 and $500 a month, or less on yearly billing.

facts.text: Every status report update stays on the status page with its timestamp, and the sample page shows components with a 45-day uptime bar.
The project README lists subscriber notifications by email and RSS.
The code is licensed under AGPL-3.0 and can be self-hosted, with Docker Compose as the recommended route.
Starter, Pro and Scale include 1, 5 and 10 status pages, and extra pages cost $20 a month each.
New users can try Starter free for 14 days without a card, after which the workspace returns to Hobby.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: 1 status page with 3 components, 1 monitor at a 10-minute minimum interval

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $300 a year on yearly billing. 1 status page, 20 components, subscribers, custom domain

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $1,000 a year on yearly billing. 5 status pages, 50 components

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: $5,000 a year on yearly billing. 10 status pages, 500 components

hiddenCosts: Extra status pages cost $20 a month each on every paid plan.
The page offers prices in USD and EUR, and we record the USD figures.
